notes.title: FlipWitch delayed until the Nov 17th!
notes.notes:
Message from Publisher

Hey guys! Critical Bliss here!

Let's start with the bad news...

Yeah, guys, we will have to call a delay on this one.

Sorry to those excited for this to release, but we had to make the call as the publisher for MomoGames to delay this game to the 17th of November. After Steam's internal checks, we feel that this title isn't ready for the public and the last thing we want to do is join the massive list of ever-growing titles released unfinished and unprepared.

We will need a bit more time to prepare this game in the standard you guys want. So hold on for a bit, and let us finish cooking!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/30c8560da66091cac5b67d90cabbf3e24ff60f9e.gif[/img]

A bit more time in the oven!

While we understand that the dev wanted to be festive and reach the Halloween period to release this title, we can't ship this title in its current state. We talked to developers, and while disappointed, they understand that our choice is for the best of the project. However, you guys won't have to wait too long, as another three weeks will be a perfect amount of time to ensure this game has the needed polish! We have invested our resources heavily to help plug up some holes and issues and will fully support the development until release.

Let's show you guys what we have been cooking in the meantime!

Critical Bliss's Contributions

As you guys know, with some of our prior releases, we aren't the type of publisher to sit on our ass, toss money to devs, and release games when they feel ready to go. We try our best (when clients are cooperative) to get involved, offer advice and guidance, and relieve some developmental stress!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/e9028088fc2bb18e0df9b9db64c14eacf2f7f8d8.png[/img]

MomoGames tried their best with minimal access to resources while also balancing working under AAA studio simultaneously (that was just draining the life out of them during development). When we finally got a build of FLIPWITCH to play, we had quite a few problems with the experience as we felt that the combat and overall game feel weren't where they should be. CB, though, isn't the type to complain without offering solutions, and sometimes, using our resources is necessary to accomplish the task.

So we gathered our guys and got to work!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/44897081e3edbde444cdb92a1a4a1719a3789677.png[/img]

By having the MomoGames give us access to the base code and all their files we could collaborate and offer our design knowledge and expertise. We retooled the damage from the ground up and changed a few mechanics regarding enemies, bosses, and hazardous terrain. We also advised improving quest systems so that erotic content matters more to the overall experience.

Our game feel teams have also expanded the witch/wizards box of tools and implemented a more engaging combat system!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/6120748ee7064702208ab29ca75eb1f3e9a79a1a.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/7e25e4b98722cf679da83c92284505ca61e95efc.gif[/img]

However, our job wasn't over with just that! We put the breaks on some of our games and had our in-house pixel artist tackle the project to remove some of the burden from MomoGames. CB has contributed to offering new animations and polish to the game's entire list of enemies and bosses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/54e701f49c5fd546a04d7aacbf60f06b9498b4a7.gif[/img]

We got far more involved with this one and have established a great relationship with MomoGames. We know publishers have a bad rap among sfw devs, so taking this leap of faith with us means a lot to us. We will continue to support them after release and may even consider doing a GODOT port (Critical Bliss's game engine of choice for the past 2 years) because… you know.

Fuck Unity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/214c91cff87a8b9344de4c405528c54c4a883c02.gif[/img]

We also assisted with the story, editing text, translation, and writing out a large portion of the H-scenes under MomoGames supervision, ensuring we stuck to the intended vision these Japanese devs wanted to do. (We're not pulling a Nintendo Tree House!)

We look forward to all of you checking out our work!

Message from Dev

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/22a5202819950420745fa495f7b9c0b745e7714e.png[/img]

Hello Everyone! <3

We are so sorry that we didn't manage to make it time... T___T

While we are sad about this development, we understand our publisher's worries and concerns.

We are incredibly happy that we took a chance to listen to them and hear them explain how passionate they were at making hentai games greater! We resonated with their mission and attempted to do a project that would meet expectations... but due to work struggles in AAA, our mental health began to deteriorate...

So we asked for their help and they gladly accepted!

Our past is full of terrible experiences with publishers, so having a company that cares so much has been a strange experience! CriticalBliss's devotion to us and all of you is surprising, and we trust their judgment to release FlipWitch with more polish and preparation. Critical Bliss has restored our faith in the value of publishers, and we want to work closely with them again to meet timelines better...

Thank you so much for your patience. <3

Back To Publisher!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/a7a935b48d60f3bd8bc00f7f068f951d104dd150.gif[/img]

Thanks guys, so much for being patient and letting Momo and Critical Bliss cook you up an excellent little genderbend-themed game for all of you to enjoy. We look forward to freeing this Japanese dev from sfw AAA hell and ensuring a solid future in the Adult indie scene under us!

FlipWitch will have 19 Bosses!
Over 40+ Erotic Scenes and Animations!
And a fantastic soundtrack that we are so excited for all of you to hear!

notes.title: Development Update - July 2023 The release period update!
notes.notes:
[h3]Dev Update[/h3]
Hello everyone!

Sorry for the delay in updating.
It's been a busy few months but it's been productive!
We have nailed down a possible release period and we're ready to share that with you all!

We're currently looking at a release between [b]Q4 2023 and Q1 2024[/b] depending on how the next few months go.
Our current trajectory means we're aiming for early Q4.

We've built in a bit of buffer time into this period so you can expect us to make a more nailed down announcement within the next few months as we test and make sure the game is stable/not buggy and playable from beginning to end with no issues.

We're stuffing the game with as much content as possible before release so look forward to a lot of fun scenes and loops :) 

This game has a lot of love in all aspects from art, animations, vfx and music!
We've tried to make this as fun of an experience as possible and will use any feedback from this game for future projects.

We're excited to finally be able to have an end goal to work towards and hopefully that love and polish will shine when you all get to play it. 

Thanks for reading, 

Momo Team <3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/4bca745add5b0f4e8e217b8c9230702bc32ae407.gif[/img][h1]Overview[/h1]
Hello again, thank you all for waiting and your patience.
We're currently all working really hard, so I hope you'll forgive the lack of polish on this update.
It feels like we're 'knee deep' in content right now and trying to finalise all these things takes a lot of energy.

We're getting into the final stages of the project and the end is in sight, but still not close enough for us to announce a date.

It's motivating to be at this point as we now just have a checklist of things to finish before we are comfortable announcing a release window.
I'll get more into details below.

[h1]Overall update[/h1]

Over the past few months we have been working on bosses/quests. These are really the last things we need to finish before we can release.

The musician has reworked and polished some boss tracks since we have the time for it.

VFX for bosses are also being given an extra polish and some bonus VFX added. It's looking great!

The update is a bit sparse but really we just need to finish the quest animations, boss battles and polish up our levels to look prettier. 

We're going through each map to finalise them 1 by 1 and so any missing things that pop up during this process are being added as well.

While this does seem straightforward it's very time consuming so [i]please[/i] don't get too hyped yet about a release date announcement.
We will announce our release date a few months in advance. So thank you for your patience again. We really appreciate it. :) 

[h1]Closing Notes[/h1]
As usual we will be active in the community and answering questions when they arise.
We'll be working on our marketing strategy soon and then we'll be able to share a lot more info about the game and what you can expect.

Thank you for reading and your interest. 

- Momo Games

notes.title: Dev Update and Release Date Change
notes.notes:
[h1]Steam Page Change Info[/h1]
Some of you may have noticed that we have changed the release date from 'Q2 2022' to 'Coming Soon' and we wanted to explain the reasons behind this change.
We also want to apologise since we no longer feel we can hit a Q2 release and we wanted to relay this information as soon as possible.

First of all, the team is still happy, passionate and motivated to work on the game which we feel is the most important. 
There is nothing to worry about, we haven't had any major shocks or changes that are going to affect development.

The major reason for this change is that we are currently implementing all the quests and scene content but these are taking a longer time than expected to do. 
We are looking at ways to speed up the process without affecting the quality.

Another reason is that we just don't want to keep people in the dark and suddenly announce that we can't hit specific dates. So the next time we announce a release date it will 100% be the date you can expect it to come out.
We feel that 'Coming Soon' reflects the game development more accurately now and that we are working on getting it released as soon as possible!

We're in a weird position where we almost have a full playable game but still have to implement a lot of the H-Content and we want to give as much love to that part of the game as we did the gameplay aspects.
Hopefully this will create a game that is a polished and enjoyable experience.

We will continue being active here and doing periodic dev updates too as well as answering any questions that pop up. 
We'll be upfront and honest about our development process so if you do have concerns please let us know.

[h1]Dev Update[/h1]
On top of this, we just want to do a small dev update on things that have been happening.

We have finished animating all the enemies and bosses. They just need some polish before release to be considered 100% final.

Level design has had a bit of a polish and we added some smaller details to make the world and atmosphere of the game feel better.

We implemented a decent chunk of questlines and dialog from the first 3 areas of the game. We're just waiting for the scenes to finish being animated so we can implement them and finalise those quests.

Gacha animations! These are just fun simple loops so we're not worried about producing a lot of these before release.

We have almost all music tracks complete (We even added extra since we have time) and have started doing final SFX too. The game is sounding great!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/3da09d1e0856ed43dadfa47fcc3318c8da5ee4fa.gif[/img]
Thank you for reading.

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Thank you from Momo Games team[/h1]
Hello everyone!

Firstly, thank you so much from all the team for helping us reach [b]30,000[/b] wishlists! 
We are so grateful our game has received so much interest and I guarantee that we will be doing our best to make this game as fun as possible.

Development is going well, we are currently implementing all the Boss Battles and Quests. 
This will take time but we will keep you updated as much as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/9e7ff95ecafb119fe8dfca80549f5eb8e46da7ec.gif[/img]


[h1]Unlock Animations anytime with the Toy Machines![/h1]

One of the fun features we implemented is a 'Gashapon' system.

As you explore different areas and find secrets you will also find 'Lucky Coins' that you can use on these machines you'll discover in world.

These are bonus animations you can unlock at any time, and you can choose which 'Theme' interests you most.
For example
[list]
[*] Animal Girls
[*] Sexy Onis
[*] Tentacles
[/list]
We plan to update these machines post release as well with bonus quests/content for quite a long time! 
It's just a fun thing we thought would add some flavour to the game and a way to celebrate big milestones.
[i](Animations below are not final, we don't want to spoil the surprises so we used an old animation from the artist ;))[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/cc05eb0086fc9cca0e437f1a6b4560bba79920b7.gif[/img]

[h1]Boss Animation Teaser[/h1]
We also tweeted an animation of one of the first bosses you will encounter.
'Ghost Boss' [i](Name not final)[/i]

We hope you enjoy some moving images and look forward to our next update when we have more fun stuff to share.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/dd7a3bd4692271d1814e31ba89f8be0e9e120f77.gif[/img]

If you want to see some small updates more frequently you can follow us on twitter:
[url=https://twitter.com/MomoEroge]MomoGames[/url]

Thank you and take care -
Momo Games Team

notes.title: Thank you!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/62043b09286e0251f7afd58edb8b71185ced3b95.gif[/img]
[h3]Thank you![/h3]
Thank you to everyone who has shown interest in the game.
We plan to update the steam page with more info asap and share more what you can expect gameplay wise.

[h3]Game info[/h3]
A rough overview is that you play as a FlipWitch who can flip between male and female allowing you to interact with NPC's and quests in different ways.
Alongside the main story (Worlds to explore, boss battles, dungeons etc) There is a puzzle solving element to find out how to unlock certain H-scenes by changing form and costumes and finding these NPC's in the world.

We also have a main 'hub' area where a lot of quests can be found that you can pursue in your own time.

The team has spent a decent amount of time making the gameplay and exploration feel fun and we hope that when we release everyone will enjoy what we have created.

Should you have any questions we will be active in the community and replying to discussions and comments. 

[h3]External Pages[/h3]
